estimand: Fixed-fit patient bootstrap, shared over policies and seeds. The disjoint development rosters are resampled separately, and official patients share one resample across both fits. ROC thresholds are fitted retrospectively within each source fit and bootstrap draw and recall is averaged across its two folds. Standardized pAUC uses centered scores up to FPR 0.4, with equal patient weight within each outcome.
primary: Patient-macro small-positive recall at retrospective 20% all-absence FPR, calibrated ordered coverage versus image difference; separately report improvement in realized adjacent absence and small label yield.

acquisition.units: Reference slice-class states among 80 new masks per fit; a physical mask can contribute several class states. Equal weight per fold and seed.
acquisition.top_k_nomination_precision_definition: Nomination-level fraction among fixed top K per fitted fold; patient-cluster bootstrap with common draws across arms and seeds.
